Adapted by Tian Yi

Feng Monian
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《单刀会》的封面页，展示了该故事的标题、来源（三国演义之三十五）及改编和绘画作者信息，配有一幅描绘关羽持刀与另一人物对峙的插图。

内容提要
上集“取成都”，叙刘备擒杀张任、收降马超，取得
西川地盘。
本集叙鲁肃向孙权献计，在陆口设宴请关羽来会，打
算威逼关羽交还荆州。关羽仅带随从数人，单刀赴会，拒绝了鲁肃
的要求。
下集“濡须之战”，叙孙权出兵进攻合肥，和曹军在濡须附近
大战。

1. 刘备收了西川，派遣使者，带了荡寇将军汉寿亭侯的印信和黄金五百
斤、白银一千斤、钱五千万、蜀锦一千匹，到荆州来封赏关羽。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
The previous chapter, "Capturing Chengdu," narrates how Liu Bei captured and killed Zhang Ren, recruited Ma Chao, and gained control of the Sichuan region.
This chapter tells of Lu Su advising Sun Quan to set a banquet at Lukou to invite Guan Yu, intending to force Guan Yu to return Jingzhou. Guan Yu, accompanied by only a few attendants, attended the meeting alone with his sword, and refused Lu Su's demands.
The next chapter, "The Battle of Ruxu," narrates Sun Quan's military campaign against Hefei and the great battle between his forces and Cao Cao's army near Ruxu.

1. After Liu Bei took control of Sichuan, he sent envoys carrying the seal and title of General Who Subdues Bandits, Marquis of Hanshouting, along with 500 jin of gold, 1,000 jin of silver, 50 million coins, and 1,000 bolts of Shu brocade, to Jingzhou to reward Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 本页包含内容提要，概述了上集、本集和下集的主要情节，并配有一幅插图，图下文字说明刘备派遣使者携带重礼前往荆州封赏关羽。

2. 关羽大喜，收下金帛，命关平跟使者到成都去拜谢刘备。他叮嘱关平：
“你告禀伯父，说我知道马超武艺过人，要到西川来跟他比个高低。”

3. 关平领命，到了成都，见刘备谢过封赏，就告禀这件事。刘备大惊道：
“云长要与马超比武，譬如两虎相争，必有一伤，如何是好？”
page_text_en:
2. Guan Yu was overjoyed, accepted the gold and silk, and ordered Guan Ping to accompany the envoy to Chengdu to thank Liu Bei. He instructed Guan Ping: 
"Inform my elder brother that I know Ma Chao is exceptionally skilled in martial arts, and I wish to come to Sichuan to challenge him to a duel." 

3. Guan Ping obeyed, arrived in Chengdu, thanked Liu Bei for the rewards, and reported this matter. Liu Bei was greatly alarmed and said: 
"If Yun Chang wishes to duel with Ma Chao, it would be like two tigers fighting—surely one will be injured. What shall we do?"
summary_zh: 关羽收下刘备的赏赐后，命关平前往成都拜谢，并叮嘱其告知刘备自己欲与马超比武；关平抵达成都后向刘备禀报此事，刘备听后大惊，担忧两虎相争必有一伤。

4. 孔明笑道：“马超在葭萌关夜战张飞，威名震动四方，云长心高气傲，所以不服。但他是识大体的人，待我写信回复他。”
5. 孔明写了书信，说马超虽勇，只能与张飞并驾齐驱，决不及将军的超群绝伦。将军镇守荆州，责任重大，切不可轻易入川，误了大事。
page_text_en:
4. Kong Ming smiled, "Ma Chao fought Zhang Fei at night at Jiamei Pass, his fame shaking the four directions. Yun Chang is proud and arrogant, so he doesn't respect him. But he is a man of great sense, let me write a letter to reply to him."
5. Kong Ming wrote a letter, saying that although Ma Chao is brave, he can only be compared with Zhang Fei, and is far inferior to the General's outstanding excellence. The General is in charge of Jingzhou, with great responsibility, and must not easily enter Sichuan, or he will make a big mistake.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮得知关羽欲与马超比武后，认为关羽心高气傲，但识大体，于是决定写信劝阻。信中称赞关羽超群绝伦，远胜马超，并强调其镇守荆州责任重大，不可轻率入川。

6. 刘备看了信，略略放心，又恐关羽性急，便把书信交给关平，教他星夜赶回荆州。
7. 关平回到荆州，关羽问起入川比武的事情。关平道：“军师有信在这里。”就把孔明的书信送上。
page_text_en:
6. Liu Bei read the letter, felt somewhat reassured, but worried that Guan Yu might act rashly, so he handed the letter to Guan Ping and instructed him to return to Jingzhou immediately.
7. Guan Ping returned to Jingzhou. Guan Yu asked about the matter of going to Shu to fight. Guan Ping said, "The military advisor has a letter here," and presented Zhuge Liang's letter.
summary_zh: 刘备收到诸葛亮的信后，将信交给关平，命其星夜赶回荆州。关平回到荆州后，向关羽呈上诸葛亮的信件。

8. 关羽看了，哈哈大笑道：“孔明懂得我的性情！”把来信给文武官员们看了，放下了入川的主意。
9. 却说东吴孙权，得知刘备并了西川，便与谋士商议道：“刘备从前借荆州，约定取了西川，便还荆州。如今他得了西川，却不把荆州还我，如何是好？”
page_text_en:
8. Guan Yu looked at it, laughed heartily, and said, "Kong Ming understands my temperament!" He showed the letter to the civil and military officials and gave up the idea of entering Sichuan.
9. Meanwhile, Sun Quan of Eastern Wu, having learned that Liu Bei had conquered Sichuan, discussed with his strategists, "Liu Bei previously borrowed Jingzhou, agreeing to return it once he took Sichuan. Now that he has obtained Sichuan, yet refuses to return Jingzhou to me—what should we do?"
summary_zh: 关羽收到诸葛亮的信后，大笑称其懂自己性情，并将信示众，放弃了入川比武的念头；与此同时，东吴孙权得知刘备夺取西川，与谋士商议如何索回荆州。

10. 张昭献计道：“孔明的胞兄诸葛瑾现在东吴为官。可把他家属拘住，教他到西川见孔明，劝刘备交还荆州。孔明顾念兄弟之情，必然应允。”
11. 孙权道：“诸葛瑾是诚实君子，怎好难为他？”张昭道：“只要让他知道这是计策，就放心了。”孙权踌躇半晌，听从了他。
page_text_en:
10. Zhang Zhao suggested: "Zhuge Liang's elder brother, Zhuge Jin, is currently serving in Eastern Wu. We could detain his family, send him to Western Shu to meet Zhuge Liang, and persuade Liu Bei to return Jingzhou. Zhuge Liang, considering his brotherly bond, will surely agree."
11. Sun Quan said: "Zhuge Jin is an honest gentleman; how could we harm him?" Zhang Zhao replied: "As long as he knows this is a strategy, you can rest assured." Sun Quan hesitated for a while, then agreed with him.
summary_zh: 东吴谋士张昭向孙权献计，建议扣留诸葛瑾的家属，逼其前往西川劝说诸葛亮交还荆州；孙权起初犹豫，后听从张昭之计。

12. 第二天，孙权就把诸葛瑾全家大小，搬到宫里居住，写了书信，打发他到西川去。
13. 诸葛瑾走了数日，到了成都郊外，先使人进城通报。
page_text_en:
12. The next day, Sun Quan moved Zhuge Jin and his entire family into the palace, wrote a letter, and sent him to Western Shu.
13. After traveling for several days, Zhuge Jin arrived at the outskirts of Chengdu and first sent someone into the city to report his arrival.
summary_zh: 孙权将诸葛瑾全家接到宫中居住，并写信派他前往西川；诸葛瑾行至成都郊外，先派人进城通报。

14. 刘备见过使者，问孔明道：“令兄为什么来？”孔明道：“来讨荆州。”刘备问他如何对付，孔明轻轻说了一个办法。
15. 孔明当下写了一封书信，教人星夜赶到荆州去交与关羽。
page_text_en:
14. Liu Bei met with the envoy and asked Kong Ming, "Why has your elder brother come?" Kong Ming replied, "He has come to claim Jingzhou." Liu Bei asked how to deal with it, and Kong Ming lightly suggested a solution.
15. Kong Ming immediately wrote a letter and sent someone to rush to Jingzhou at night to deliver it to Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 刘备接见东吴使者，得知孙权派其兄来讨荆州，便向诸葛亮询问对策；诸葛亮随即写信，派人星夜送往荆州交予关羽。

16. 他出城迎接诸葛瑾。兄弟相见，说了些别后情况，便一同进城。
17. 孔明把诸葛瑾送进宾馆，参拜完毕，诸葛瑾忽然放声大哭。孔明惊道：“兄长有事请说，为什么悲痛？”诸葛瑾道：“我一家老小都完了！”便把吴侯拘他家属，说了一遍。
page_text_en:
16. He went out of the city to welcome Zhuge Jin. Brothers reunited, exchanged some news since their parting, and then entered the city together.
17. Kongming escorted Zhuge Jin to the guesthouse. After the formal greetings, Zhuge Jin suddenly burst into tears. Kongming was startled and asked, “Brother, please speak. Why are you so sorrowful?” Zhuge Jin replied, “My entire family is ruined!” He then recounted how the Lord of Wu had detained his family.
summary_zh: 刘备出城迎接东吴使者诸葛瑾，兄弟相见后一同进城；诸葛亮将诸葛瑾安置于宾馆，诸葛瑾因家人被孙权扣留而悲痛大哭，向诸葛亮说明情况。

18. 孔明道：“累了兄长，我心里不安，且勿忧虑，想法还荆州就是了。”诸葛瑾心里欢喜，揩了眼泪，便要孔明同去见刘备。
19. 刘备看了孙权的信，发怒道：“孙权把他的妹妹嫁了我，却乘我不在荆州，接走了她，情理难容。我正要大起川兵，杀下江南问罪，他还想来要荆州！”，
page_text_en:
18. Kongming said, "Brother, you've been worn out. I feel uneasy, but please don't worry. Just think about returning Jingzhou." Zhuge Jin, overjoyed, wiped his tears and asked Kongming to go together to see Liu Bei.
19. Liu Bei read Sun Quan's letter and became furious, saying, "Sun Quan married his sister to me, yet while I was not in Jingzhou, he took her away. This is intolerable. I am about to raise a large army from Shu and march south to punish him—how dare he still come to demand Jingzhou!"
summary_zh: 诸葛亮安慰诸葛瑾，表示会想办法归还荆州；刘备看到孙权的信后大怒，指责孙权背信弃义，扬言要出兵讨伐。

20. 诸葛瑾还未开口，孔明已经哭拜在地，说：“孙权拘了我兄全家老小，倘若不还荆州，岂不害了我兄。请主公看我薄面，还了荆州。”
21. 刘备再三不肯，孔明只是哭求。刘备渐渐松了口，说：“既然如此，看在军师面上，还他一半，把长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡给他。”
page_text_en:
20. Before Zhuge Jin could speak, Kong Ming had already wept and knelt on the ground, saying, 'Sun Quan has detained my brother's entire family, young and old. If we do not return Jingzhou, won't it harm my brother? Please, Your Majesty, for my sake, return Jingzhou.'
21. Liu Bei repeatedly refused, but Kong Ming kept weeping and pleading. Gradually, Liu Bei relented and said, 'If that is the case, for the sake of the Military Adviser, I will return half of it—give him the three commanderies of Changsha, Lingling, and Guiyang.'
summary_zh: 诸葛亮为救兄长全家，向刘备哭求归还荆州，刘备最终同意归还长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡。

22. 诸葛瑾不敢再说，便请行文荆州，交割三郡。刘备叮嘱道：“你见了我弟，要好好求他。他脾气暴烈，我也怕他。你一定要小心。”
23. 诸葛瑾拿了交割文书，辞了刘备，别了孔明，往荆州来求见关羽。
page_text_en:
22. Zhuge Jin dared not speak further, so he requested that a formal document be sent to Jingzhou to hand over the three commanderies. Liu Bei instructed him: 'When you see my younger brother, you must beg him earnestly. He has a fierce temper, and even I fear him. You must be very careful.'
23. Zhuge Jin took the document of surrender, bid farewell to Liu Bei, parted from Kongming, and set off for Jingzhou to seek an audience with Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 刘备叮嘱诸葛瑾前往荆州向关羽请求交割三郡，强调关羽脾气暴烈需小心应对；诸葛瑾随后带着文书辞别刘备和诸葛亮，前往荆州求见关羽。

24. 关羽早已接到孔明书信，看了文书，大怒道：“三郡都是大汉疆土，为什么要给东吴？‘将在外，君命有所不受。’我兄虽然应允，我却只是不还。”
25. 诸葛瑾求道：“吴侯捉下了我的全家老小，不还荆州，就都难保性命，请将军见怜。”关羽冷笑道：“这是孙权的计策，如何瞒得过我！”
page_text_en:
24. Guan Yu had already received Zhuge Liang's letter. After reading the document, he angrily said, "The three commanderies are all territories of the Han dynasty. Why should I give them to Eastern Wu? 'When a general is in the field, he may not obey the orders of his sovereign.' Although my brother agreed, I will not return them."
25. Zhuge Jin pleaded, "The Lord of Wu has detained my entire family. If you do not return Jingzhou, we will all lose our lives. I beg you, General, to have mercy." Guan Yu coldly laughed, "This is Sun Quan's scheme. How could it deceive me!"
summary_zh: 关羽接到诸葛亮书信后拒绝归还三郡，认为其为大汉疆土；诸葛瑾以家人被扣为由恳求，关羽则识破孙权计谋，拒绝妥协。

26. 诸葛瑾道：“将军怎么不讲些儿情面？”关羽脸上变了色，飕的拔出了宝剑，喝道：“住口，这剑上并没有情面！”
27. 关平上前告道：“军师面上不好看，请父亲息怒。”关羽收回了宝剑，说：“不看军师面上，教你回不得东吴，赶紧走吧！”
page_text_en:
26. Zhuge Jin said, "General, why don't you show a little leniency?" Guan Yu's face changed color; he swiftly drew his sword and shouted, "Silence! There is no leniency on this sword!"
27. Guan Ping stepped forward and said, "It would not look good for the Master Strategist. Please, Father, calm down." Guan Yu sheathed his sword and said, "If not for the Master Strategist's sake, I would not let you return to Eastern Wu. Leave at once!"
summary_zh: 诸葛瑾劝说关羽归还三郡，关羽大怒拔剑相向，后被儿子关平劝阻，最终怒斥诸葛瑾离开。

28. 诸葛瑾无奈，只得出来。暗想，只有再见孔明，请他设法交割，便重新乘了船，往西川来。
29. 诸葛瑾再到成都，孔明已经出巡去了。他只得求见刘备，把关羽不肯交割三郡的事，一一说了。
page_text_en:
28. Zhu Ge Jin, helpless, had to come out. He thought to himself, 'I can only meet Kong Ming again and ask him to find a way to hand over the three commanderies,' so he boarded a boat once more and headed for Shu.
29. When Zhu Ge Jin arrived in Chengdu again, Kong Ming had already gone on an inspection tour. He could only seek an audience with Liu Bei and told him, one by one, about Guan Yu's refusal to hand over the three commanderies.
summary_zh: 诸葛瑾因关羽拒绝交割三郡而无奈返回成都，但诸葛亮已出巡，他只得向刘备汇报此事。

30. 刘备道：“我弟是个性急人，一时也讲不通。请你先回东吴，待我取了东川、汉中等地，把我弟调来，那时就把荆州交还。”
31. 诸葛瑾没奈何，只得回报孙权。孙权大怒道：“恐怕这都是诸葛亮的计策吧？”诸葛瑾道：“不是；我弟再三哀求，刘备才答应先还三郡，可是关羽不答应。”
page_text_en:
30. Liu Bei said, "My brother is an impatient man; I can't reason with him right now. Please return to Eastern Wu first. Once I have taken Dongchuan, Hanzhong, and other territories, I will recall my brother, and then I will return Jingzhou to you."
31. Zhu Ge Jin had no choice but to report back to Sun Quan. Sun Quan angrily said, "Perhaps this is all Zhuge Liang's scheme?" Zhu Ge Jin replied, "No; my brother pleaded repeatedly, and Liu Bei agreed to return the three commanderies first, but Guan Yu refused."
summary_zh: 刘备向诸葛瑾承诺，待取下东川、汉中等地后，再调回关羽归还荆州；诸葛瑾无奈返回东吴，向孙权汇报关羽拒绝交割三郡，孙权怀疑是诸葛亮的计策。

32. 孙权道：“既然刘备肯先还三郡，我们只管派人接收去。”便教诸葛瑾把家属带回，一面差官分别去接收长沙、零陵、桂阳。
33. 不过几天，派去的人都被赶回来了，说关羽不肯移交，把他们连夜押解出境。
page_text_en:
32. Sun Quan said, "Since Liu Bei is willing to return the three commanderies first, we'll just send people to receive them." He then ordered Zhu Ge Jin to bring back his family, and sent officials to receive Changsha, Lingling, and Guiyang.
33. In just a few days, the people sent there were driven back, saying that Guan Yu refused to hand them over and had them escorted out of the territory at night.
summary_zh: 孙权决定接收刘备归还的三郡，并派官吏前往接收，同时让诸葛瑾接回家人；但不久后，派去的官吏被关羽驱逐并押解出境，三郡未能顺利交接。

34. 孙权大怒，决意进攻荆州，召集谋士商谈。张昭道：“东吴连年太平，用兵便要劳民，还是用计的好。”可是议了半天，议不出万全之策。
35. 孙权一口气无处出，怪怨鲁肃，责他道：“当初是你作保，把荆州借与刘备，说明得了西川便还。如今刘备失了信，你这个保人怎么说？ ”
page_text_en:
34. Sun Quan was furious and decided to attack Jingzhou, summoning his strategists for discussion. Zhang Zhao said, 'Eastern Wu has enjoyed peace for years; using troops would burden the people. It would be better to use strategy.' However, after debating for a long time, they could not devise a foolproof plan.
35. Sun Quan, unable to vent his frustration, blamed Lu Su and scolded him: 'It was you who guaranteed the loan of Jingzhou to Liu Bei, promising it would be returned once he gained Xichuan. Now that Liu Bei has broken his word, what do you, the guarantor, have to say? '
summary_zh: 孙权因刘备未归还荆州而大怒，召集谋士商议进攻之策，但未能达成共识；随后他迁怒于当初担保借荆州的鲁肃，责问其失信之责。

36. 鲁肃连忙说：“我已想了一个办法，正要告诉主公。”孙权叫他讲出来。
37. 鲁肃献计道：“我们可在陆口屯下兵，请关羽来会。他来了，便请他交还三郡，答应了便罢，不答应就杀了他。如果不来，我们出兵进攻，就是师出有名。”
page_text_en:
36. Lu Su hurriedly said, “I’ve already thought of a plan, and I’m about to tell Your Majesty.” Sun Quan told him to speak up.
37. Lu Su proposed, “We can station troops at Lukou and invite Guan Yu to meet. If he comes, we’ll ask him to return the three commanderies; if he agrees, we’ll let it go; if he refuses, we’ll kill him. If he doesn’t come, we’ll launch an attack, and that will be a just cause for war.”
summary_zh: 鲁肃向孙权献计，建议在陆口屯兵，邀请关羽前来会面，若其不归还三郡则杀之，若不来则以此为名出兵进攻。

38. 孙权点了点头，要他立刻行动。这时，阚泽站出来说：“不可。关云长乃当今的虎将，非普通人可及。万一不成功，还要受他的害哩。”
39. 孙权忍耐不住，发话道：“要是这样畏首畏尾的，荆州何时才能到手！”他不让阚泽分辩，叫鲁肃按计行事。
page_text_en:
38. Sun Quan nodded and ordered him to act immediately. At this moment, Kan Ze stepped forward and said, "No. Guan Yunchang is a tiger general of today, beyond the reach of ordinary people. If we fail, we will still suffer harm from him." 
39. Sun Quan could no longer hold back and said, "If we continue to be timid and hesitant, when will Jingzhou ever be ours!" He wouldn't let Kan Ze argue further, and ordered Lu Su to carry out the plan.
summary_zh: 孙权决定采取行动夺取荆州，阚泽劝阻称关羽勇猛难敌，但孙权不听，坚持让鲁肃按计行事。

40. 鲁肃赶到陆口，与守将吕蒙、甘宁商议，决定在陆口寨外临江亭上设下筵席，请关羽来会。
41. 鲁肃写了请柬，挑一个能言善辩的人，吩咐他过江去请关羽。
page_text_en:
40. Lu Su arrived at Lukou and discussed with the garrison commanders Lü Meng and Gan Ning. They decided to set up a banquet at a pavilion by the river outside the Lukou camp to invite Guan Yu to meet.
41. Lu Su wrote an invitation and chose a persuasive person, instructing him to cross the river to invite Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 鲁肃抵达陆口，与吕蒙、甘宁商议后，决定在临江亭设宴邀请关羽，并派遣使者过江传信。

42. 使者领命，便乘舟向荆州来。
43. 使者见了关羽，道了来意。关羽看了书信，欣然道：“既是鲁大夫相请，我明天就过江来会。”
page_text_en:
42. The envoy received his orders and set off by boat toward Jingzhou.
43. The envoy met Guan Yu and explained the purpose of his visit. Guan Yu read the letter and replied cheerfully, "Since it is Master Lu who has invited me, I will cross the river to meet him tomorrow."
summary_zh: 使者乘船前往荆州，向关羽传达鲁肃的邀请，关羽欣然答应次日过江赴会。

44. 使者去后，关平谏道：“鲁肃相邀，必无好意，父亲不应赴会。”关羽笑道：“东吴讨不到三郡，所以屯兵陆口，约我去会，好讨荆州。要是不去，便道我胆小了。”
45. 关平劝他不要冒险。关羽道：“我在千军万马之中，如入无人之境，怕什么江东的鼠辈。明日我只带十几个随从，单刀赴会，看鲁肃能怎么样！”
page_text_en:
44. After the envoy left, Guan Ping advised, "Lu Su's invitation must be ill-intentioned; Father should not attend." Guan Yu laughed, "Eastern Wu cannot obtain the three commanderies, so they have stationed troops at Lukou and invited me to meet, hoping to claim Jingzhou. If I don't go, they will say I am cowardly.
45. Guan Ping urged him not to take the risk. Guan Yu said, "In the midst of thousands of troops, I move as if in an empty land. What do I fear from the Eastern Wu scoundrels? Tomorrow, I will bring only a dozen followers, attend the meeting alone with my single sword, and see what Lu Su can do!"
summary_zh: 关平劝关羽不要赴鲁肃之约，认为有危险；关羽自信满满，表示要单刀赴会，以示胆量。

46. 谋士马良也谏道：“鲁肃是个老实人，但事情急了，难保没有诡计，将军还是不去的好。”关羽笑道：“我力敌万人，怕什么！而且已经答应了，岂能失信。”
47. 马良道：“将军即使要去，也要有个准备。”关羽便吩咐关平挑选快船十只，精兵五百人，明天在江边等候。只看大船上的大旗招展，便过江来迎接。
page_text_en:
46. The strategist Ma Liang advised, "Lu Su is an honest man, but in an emergency, we can't rule out a trick. General, it's better not to go." Guan Yu laughed, "I can face ten thousand enemies. What do I fear? And I've already agreed. How could I break my word?"
47. Ma Liang said, "Even if you go, General, you must be prepared." Guan Yu then ordered Guan Ping to select ten swift boats and five hundred elite soldiers to wait by the riverbank tomorrow. As soon as they saw the large flag on the big ship waving, they were to cross the river to meet him.
summary_zh: 关羽在谋士马良劝阻下仍决定赴鲁肃之约，但为防不测，吩咐关平准备快船和精兵在江边接应。

48. 再说，东吴使者回报鲁肃，鲁肃疑惑不定，问吕蒙作何打算。
49. 吕蒙主张：如果关羽带军马来，他和甘宁各领一军伏于岸旁，放炮为号，准备厮杀；如无军马，只在亭后伏下五十名刀斧手，在筵席间动手。
page_text_en:
48. Meanwhile, the Eastern Wu envoy reported back to Lu Su. Lu Su was uncertain and asked Lü Meng what he intended to do.
49. Lü Meng proposed: If Guan Yu comes with his army, he and Gan Ning will each lead a force hidden by the shore, and upon firing a cannon, they will prepare to fight; if Guan Yu comes without troops, they will hide fifty axe-wielding soldiers behind the pavilion and strike during the banquet.
summary_zh: 东吴使者向鲁肃汇报关羽赴会之事，鲁肃犹豫不决，询问吕蒙的对策；吕蒙提出两种方案：若关羽带兵，则伏兵于岸旁放炮为号发动攻击；若关羽单刀赴会，则在亭后埋伏刀斧手于筵席间动手。

50. 第二天，鲁肃安排停当，便到江口遥望。晌午时候，只见对江有一条船离了岸，缓缓而来。
51. 船到江心，船上的一面大旗直在风里招展；旗上显出了一个大“关”字。
page_text_en:
50. The next day, Lu Su had everything arranged and went to the river mouth to look out. At noon, he saw a boat leave the opposite shore and come slowly.
51. When the boat reached the center of the river, a large flag on it fluttered in the wind; on the flag was a big character 'Guan'.
summary_zh: 第二天晌午，鲁肃在江口等待，只见关羽的船从对岸缓缓驶来，船至江心时，一面写有“关”字的大旗在风中招展。

53. 鲁肃惊疑不定，把关羽接上岸来。望望船里，只有梢公、水手，并无军马。但看到周仓拿着一把寒光闪闪的青龙偃月刀，紧紧跟着关羽。

52. Guan Yu, wearing a green hat and green robe, sits at the bow of the boat; Zhou Cang holds a large sword, and eight or nine big men from Guanxi, each carrying a waist knife, stand on both sides.
53. Lu Su, filled with surprise and doubt, brings Guan Yu ashore. He looks into the boat and sees only boatmen and sailors, with no soldiers. But he sees Zhou Cang holding a cold, gleaming Green Dragon Crescent Blade, closely following Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 关羽单刀赴会，乘船抵达江岸，鲁肃接其上岸，发现船上无军马，唯周仓持青龙偃月刀随行，令鲁肃惊疑。

54. 两人客套了几句，并肩往临江亭来。关羽道：“你我在临江会一别，想不到直到如今才得见面。”鲁肃说：“是呀，光阴似箭，日月如梭。君侯你倒不见老，我却苍老了。”
55. 关羽哈哈大笑，说彼此都是一样。然后问道：“不知大夫相邀，有何见教？”鲁肃说：“孙刘结联唇齿之好，使曹操不敢正视东南；如今在这临江亭摆设菲筵，聊表敬意。”
page_text_en:
54. The two exchanged a few polite words and walked shoulder to shoulder toward the Lijing Pavilion. Guan Yu said, "We parted at the Lijing meeting, and I never thought we would meet again only now." Lu Su replied, "Indeed, time flies like an arrow, and days and months pass like a shuttle. Your Excellency, you don't seem to have aged, but I have grown old." 
55. Guan Yu laughed heartily, saying they were both the same. He then asked, "I wonder, Master Lu, what is the purpose of your invitation?" Lu Su said, "The alliance between Sun and Liu is like lips and teeth; it has made Cao Cao dare not look toward the southeast. Today, I have set up a modest banquet at this Lijing Pavilion to express my respect."
summary_zh: 关羽与鲁肃在临江亭会面，两人寒暄并回忆往昔，鲁肃以设宴为名表达敬意，实则暗藏试探与谋略。

57. 吃了一会，鲁肃鼓起勇气说：“从前令兄皇叔，使肃在我主面前，保借荆州暂住，约定在取西川之后归还。今西川已得，而荆州未还，在信用上说不过去吧。”
page_text_en:
56. They arrived at the Lingjiang Pavilion, exchanged greetings, and then sat down to drink. Lu Su offered a few cups, but seeing Guan Yu laughing and talking as if no one else were present, he was startled and dared not speak.
57. After a while, Lu Su gathered his courage and said, "Formerly, your brother, Lord Huan, asked me to request from my lord the temporary loan of Jingzhou, with the agreement to return it after taking Xichuan. Now that Xichuan has been secured, but Jingzhou has not yet been returned, it is hard to justify this on grounds of credibility, is it not?"
summary_zh: 关羽与鲁肃在临江亭饮酒，鲁肃见关羽从容不迫，不敢开口；稍后，鲁肃鼓起勇气，以刘备借荆州未还为由，向关羽提出归还荆州的请求。

58. 关羽道：“这是国家大事，不是酒席上谈的。”鲁肃道：“令兄已允先还三郡，将军坚持不交，恐怕道理上说不过去。”
59. 关羽道：“当初赤壁之战，是两家同心才破了曹操，又不是无功受禄，强占荆州。”鲁肃道：“令兄得了西川，又要荆州，贪利失信，要受天下人耻笑。”
page_text_en:
58. Guan Yu said, "This is a matter of national importance, not something to be discussed at a banquet." Lu Su replied, "Your elder brother has already agreed to return the three commanderies first. If you insist on not returning them, it恐怕 won't hold up logically." 
59. Guan Yu said, "During the Battle of Red Cliffs, it was only through the joint efforts of our two sides that we defeated Cao Cao. We did not seize Jingzhou without merit." Lu Su replied, "Your elder brother has already gained Xichuan, yet now demands Jingzhou too. This is greedy and dishonest, and will bring shame upon you before the whole world."
summary_zh: 关羽与鲁肃在临江亭宴饮，鲁肃以刘备曾允诺归还三郡为由，要求关羽交还荆州；关羽则以赤壁之战双方合力破曹为由，拒绝归还，并指责鲁肃无理取闹。

64. On the other side, Guan Ping had been on lookout. Seeing the large flag flutter, he gave the order, and ten swift boats shot across the river like arrows.
65. Guan Yu held his sword in his right hand and grasped Lu Su with his left, speaking drunkenly: 'You invited me to drink today; why bring up the matter of Jingzhou? I'm drunk, and I might hurt our relationship. Let's discuss it another day when you come to Jingzhou.'
summary_zh: 关平见关羽信号旗招动，立即下令十艘快船疾驰过江；关羽则佯装醉酒，挽住鲁肃，以酒席为由推脱归还荆州之事，约定改日于荆州再议。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义35：单刀会》
title_en: Comic Book 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 35: The Single Sword Meeting'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义35：单刀会》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
66. 鲁肃吓得魂不附体，被关羽扯到江边。吕蒙、甘宁想要出兵拦截，又怕伤了鲁肃，只得不动。
67. 关羽到了船边，才放下鲁肃，跨上大船，回过头来，拱手道谢。
page_text_en:
66. Lu Su was terrified, his soul seemingly leaving his body, as Guan Yu dragged him to the riverbank. Lü Meng and Gan Ning wanted to send troops to intercept, but fearing they might harm Lu Su, they could only stand still.
67. When Guan Yu reached the boat, he let go of Lu Su, stepped onto the large ship, turned back, and bowed his hands in thanks.
summary_zh: 关羽将鲁肃拖至江边，吕蒙、甘宁不敢拦截；关羽登船后回身向鲁肃拱手道谢，完成单刀赴会。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义35：单刀会》
title_en: Comic Book 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 35: The Single Sword Meeting'

page_text_ocr_zh:
68. 鲁肃如痴如呆地站在岸边，看关羽的船乘风破浪，驶向北岸去了。
69. 鲁肃懊懊恼恼地跟吕蒙商量。吕蒙道：“只有去禀告主公，起兵与关羽决战，夺还荆州。”
page_text_en:
68. Lu Su stood by the shore, stunned, watching Guan Yu's ship sail swiftly toward the northern bank.
69. Lu Su, frustrated and annoyed, discussed the matter with Lü Meng. Lü Meng said, "We can only report to our lord and raise troops to fight Guan Yu and reclaim Jingzhou."
summary_zh: 关羽单刀赴会后安然返回江北，鲁肃呆立岸边，懊恼不已，与吕蒙商议后决定向主公禀报，起兵夺回荆州。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义35：单刀会》
title_en: Comic Book 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 35: The Single Sword Meeting'

70. 鲁肃没奈何，只得来报告孙权。孙权满怀愤怒，便召集谋臣，商议调集大军，攻取荆州。
71. 商议未定，忽然探马报来，说曹操起了三十万大军，来攻东吴。孙权大惊，只得丢下了荆州，先调兵抵敌曹操去了。欲知后事，请看下集《濡须之战》
page_text_en:
70. Lu Su had no choice but to report to Sun Quan. Sun Quan, full of anger, summoned his strategists to discuss raising a large army to attack Jingzhou.
71. Before they could decide, a scout suddenly reported that Cao Cao had raised an army of 300,000 to attack Eastern Wu. Sun Quan was greatly alarmed and had no choice but to abandon Jingzhou and first mobilize troops to resist Cao Cao. To learn what happens next, please read the next chapter, 'The Battle of Ru Xu.'
summary_zh: 鲁肃向孙权报告关羽单刀赴会后安然返回，孙权愤怒召集谋臣商议攻取荆州；但尚未定夺，便接到曹操率三十万大军进攻东吴的急报，孙权只得放弃荆州，先调兵抵御曹操。
